en: Changed `deniedMcpServers` URL entries to also block Anthropic-provided servers whose upstream URL matches, and connectors in cloud sessions and on self-hosted runners, where the session is given the connector's own URL; otherwise deny a connector by name
zh: 变更：`deniedMcpServers` 中的 URL 条目现在也会阻止上游 URL 匹配的 Anthropic 提供的服务器，以及在 cloud session 和自托管运行器中的 connector（此时 session 会获得 connector 自身的 URL）；否则请按名称阻止 connector
